_comment: Maintained list of the latest known exam outline per certification. When a vendor publishes a new outline, bump that cert's outline + asOf (and add a note). Every AEGIS install flags it on next online load. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Always confirm on the official page linked in the app.

cc.note: ISC2 refreshes the CC outline on Sept 1, 2026 — its first major content update, with deeper AI coverage. Re-verify the domains before testing on/after that date.
